about: Raw inputs of the lane analysis (14_lane_priority.py, 15_lane_network.py, 16_route_graph.py), pinned to the exact file used. fetch_inputs.py downloads each one, refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs, and unpacks it. The other inputs are in git under data/ (see 'in_git'), so the commit pins them.

osm.what: OpenStreetMap extract of the Comunidad de Madrid, snapshot of 1 January 2026 (replication timestamp 2026-01-01T21:21:30Z)
osm.note: Geofabrik keeps the 1 January snapshot of every year; daily and monthly files are removed after a while, and BBBike's extract is overwritten every week, so neither can be fetched again.

trips.what: BiciMAD trip-by-trip records 2023 (1 January - 18 February 2023): trips_23_01_January.csv, trips_23_02_February.csv (each in its own zip inside the archive)
trips.license: EMT Madrid open data terms, as linked from the datos.madrid.es entry (https://mobilitylabs.emtmadrid.es/sip/terms-of-use)

traffic.what: Average daily motor traffic per road section, 2019 (IMD_2019.shp)

dem.what: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, tile N40 W004
dem.publisher: European Space Agency, hosted on the AWS Registry of Open Data
dem.license: Copernicus DEM licence (free use with attribution: 'produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved')

in_git.data/madrid_bike_accidents.csv: Bicycle accidents, Policia Municipal (https://datos.madrid.es/dataset/300110-0-accidentes-bicicleta), written by pipeline/refresh.py
in_git.data/refresh_meta.json: Date of the latest accident in that file (accidents_latest), written by pipeline/refresh.py in the same commit
in_git.data/madrid_bike_infrastructure.csv: Cycling infrastructure layer, Ayuntamiento geoportal (https://geoportal.madrid.es/fsdescargas/IDEAM_WBGEOPORTAL/OBRAS/BICI/Infraestructura_Ciclista.zip), written by pipeline/refresh.py
in_git.data/madrid_bike_counters.csv: Bike counters, 2023 average daily bikes (https://datos.madrid.es/dataset/300321-0-aforos-peatones-bicicletas), written by pipeline/historical/06_districts_counters.py
